source_note: 收敛的连乘积的上界估计与糖水不等式
english_source_note: Upper Bounds for Convergent Products and the Sugar-Water Inequality
callout_id: 收敛的连乘积的上界估计与糖水不等式#1
statement_en: Let $$a_n=\frac{4+3^n}{2+3^n}.$$ Prove that $$\prod_{n\leq N} a_n<2$$ for every positive integer $N$.
prerequisites: properties of finite products of positive numbers
callout_body: $$a_n=\frac{4+3^n}{2+3^n}$$证明$$\prod_{n\leq N}a_n<2$$对任意正整数$N$成立.
